user.title: Configure Liquipedia
user.description: Choose what you want to follow.

team_name.title: Enter an organization
team_name.description: Enter the name of the esports organization you want to follow.

team_games.title: Choose games
team_games.description: Select one or more games to follow for {team_name}.

team_page.title: Confirm the team in {game}
team_page.description: Confirm the Liquipedia team page for {team_name}. To use a different page, enter its title.

tournament_game.title: Choose the tournament game
tournament_game.description: Choose a game to load its ongoing tournaments and those starting in the next 30 days.

data_description.team_filter: Show only matches involving this team.

tournament.title: Choose a tournament
tournament.description: Select a tournament in progress or starting in the next 30 days. If yours is missing, choose manual entry.

manual.title: Enter a match schedule
manual.description: Enter the Liquipedia Match Schedule page title, such as First Stand Tournament/2026/Match Schedule.

error.invalid_mode: Select what you want to follow.

error.cannot_connect_team: Unable to check the Liquipedia team page. Try again.
error.invalid_tournament: Select a tournament from the list.

error.no_tournaments: No tournaments were found in this period. You can enter a schedule manually.
error.no_schedule: No supported match schedule was found. Choose another tournament or enter its schedule manually.

abort.already_configured: You already follow this organization or tournament.
